research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing sentiment classifiers on paired sentences with negation, preserving topic and vocabulary wherever possible.
Analyzed prediction changes across negation scope and sentence complexity, distinguishing polarity errors from sensitivity to unrelated lexical substitutions.

research.title: Evidence Consistency in Abstractive Summarization
bullets: Designed evaluation experiments comparing summary factuality under source truncation and sentence reordering, using consistent decoding settings across conditions.
Analyzed unsupported claims through manual error categorization and entailment scores, examining disagreements between automated assessments and source evidence.

research.title: Evidence Robustness in Retrieval-Based Question Answering
bullets: Designed experiments isolating passage relevance, evidence position, and distractor similarity in question answering with retrieved textual context.
Analyzed answer accuracy and abstention behavior across retrieval conditions, using passage ablations to distinguish retrieval failures from evidence interpretation errors.

work.title: Text Record Validation and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented input validation and text normalization for an existing record search service, following established interface requirements and review procedures.
Added regression tests for malformed records and updated error handling, documenting reproducible failures for maintenance discussions.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and embedding-based document retrieval pipelines with shared preprocessing, query sets, and relevance judgments for comparative evaluation.
Compared ranking quality and query latency, inspecting failures involving rare terminology, paraphrases, and documents containing repeated query terms.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented recurrent and transformer-based sequence labeling baselines, applying identical token alignment rules and dataset partitions for comparison.
Evaluated entity span precision and recall, categorizing boundary errors and confusions involving ambiguous names and infrequent entity types.

projects.title: Confidence Calibration for Text Classification
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and an uncalibrated baseline for a text classifier, fitting calibration parameters on a separate validation partition.
Compared calibration error and selective prediction behavior, examining how confidence estimates varied across document length and class frequency.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented graph-based and centroid-based sentence ranking methods for extractive summarization, holding sentence segmentation and summary length constraints constant.
Compared reference overlap and content redundancy, manually inspecting summaries for missing central claims and unresolved references.
